text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, amazing! You danced all the way 
through! By the way, it's your day off, 
aren't you gonna rest~?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Dancing through the night, just following 
my heart! That's my kind of day off.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Let's dance to our hearts' content 
tonight!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was so engrossed in dancing that she 
cut into her sleep... and was unable to 
rest properly.
